source: AAN 2023 Clinical Practice Guideline on Parkinson's Disease Management
recommendations: Refer to neurologist for diagnostic confirmation and management plan
Consider initiation of levodopa (or dopamine agonist in younger patients) to manage motor symptoms
Recommend structured physical therapy program focusing on balance, gait, and strengthening
Implement safety assessment for fall prevention at home
Screen for non-motor symptoms: depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, and cognitive impairment

follow_up.action: Neurology consultation and home safety evaluation
Evaluate initial response to dopamine replacement therapy and adjust dosage
Follow up to monitor motor performance, dyskinesias, and medication side effects
Multidisciplinary team review: physical therapy, occupational therapy, and cognitive screening

contraindications.action: Contraindicated; can severely worsen parkinsonian symptoms

emergency_signs: Parkinsonian crises: severe dysphagia leading to aspiration, sudden loss of mobility (freezing), dopamine dysregulation syndrome, or severe orthostatic hypotension leading to syncope
references: AAN Clinical Practice Guideline on the Treatment of Early Parkinson's Disease
